data.purpose: Owns generic Grammar format algebra; concrete Artifact Binary/COFF/PE readers and writers; Build Cache and Manifest; verified objects, verified linking, and .gobj serialization. Implements g-design-owned ARTIFACTS.md, GRAMMAR.md, and OLEAN_SHARDING.md without redefining their normative contracts. Consumes raw layout/link descriptions from g-construct, consumes x86 encoding facts from c-x86, and consumes the Grass.Verify/Certificate gate from g-foundation.

data.note: Exclusive implementation ownership for Grammar, Artifact Binary/COFF/PE, Build Cache/Manifest, tests, the implementation plan, and VERIFIED_OBJECTS.md. ARTIFACTS.md and GRAMMAR.md remain g-design normative; OLEAN_SHARDING.md remains g-design normative and cross-cutting while g-build implements its artifact/build constraints. Seam rules: consume raw layout/link descriptions from g-construct; c-x86 owns x86 encoding/decoding facts while g-build owns generic format algebra; Build/Manifest consumes rather than redefines g-foundation Verify/Certificate gates. VALIDATION.md is intentionally unclaimed.

risks: The c-x86 decoder seam must be agreed before instruction decoder work.
Foundational certificate and raw-layout interfaces may still evolve; adapters must remain below their owners.
Round-trip alone is insufficient parser correctness; malformed, truncated, and overflow cases require explicit laws and fixtures.
Build-locality claims must remain measured and must not promise constant-time relinking.

steps.text: Write ARTIFACT_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md with ownership seams, dependency graph, acceptance gates, and clean bug inventory.
Implement typed generic binary grammar plus total streaming reader/writer state and round-trip/prefix laws.
Implement canonical .gobj payload grammar, parser/writer, structural validation, and exact payload resolution boundary.
Implement COFF and PE32+ modeled subsets over generic grammar, consuming x86 relocation and encoding facts without owning them.
Implement verified-object signatures and linker composition over g-construct layouts and g-foundation certificate gates.
Implement semantic-environment Merkle cache keys, measured shard manifests, hierarchical certificates, and rebuild-cone fixtures.

data.summary: Establish artifact and build architecture, then implement and verify generic binary grammar before COFF/PE, verified-object linking, and measured cache/manifest composition.
